closing.reason: (1) Other entry points: _regrain_copy_make is the only maker of regrain copies (regrain_step at 8374, and the probe in _regrain_fresh_copy_drift at 6617), and regrain_step's swap at 8599 is the only ATTACH of a regrain copy. regrain(), regrain_history(), regrain_step and auto-regrain (maintain) all go through it. The other core LIKE ... INCLUDING CONSTRAINTS site, the transmute cutover (10984), refuses a NOT VALID CHECK in its preflight (_transmute_refuse_uncarried_constraints, #730), which is documented. The ATTACH at 4135 re-attaches a detached retirement partition, which keeps its own NOT VALID constraint and copies no rows. untransmute makes no LIKE copy. uninstall.sql has no copy path. (2) Upgrade or resume path, measured on pgpm_prv-15: base install, a NOT VALID CHECK that row 150 violates, regrain_step ran prepared, copied:99, then died 23514 on every tick (S1's copy holds the CHECK validated). Installing the head over that state and ticking on gave restarted:1, the copy ticks, then swapped:10. Row 150 is still served, and the log shows regrain_restart naming the copy's validated up_no_bad, then copy_swap_drop. So the body's sentence 'A run that was wedged by this defect is unwedged the same way' holds. The scheduled path is the same regrain_step. The drift check runs before the reconcile, the copy and the swap on every tick, so a wedged copy phase reaches it. (3) The body's guarantees: the mid-run CHECK (test B), the copy that holds the CHECK validated after a drop and re-add (test C, restart, and the probe matches so it is not a refusal) and the swap's 'keeps it' arm (reachable only by a copy that matches by name, and a validated one is drift first) left no input I could break on 15. PostgreSQL 18's NOT VALID NOT NULL arm could not be run (this harness has 15 only). The body discloses pgpm_hypertable's from_hypertable LIKE copy (install.sql:1184) as not covered. It is a sibling mechanism outside the PR's claimed surface, and it cannot be built here: pgpm_prv-15 has no timescaledb. It is a lead to file, not a partial. (4) Mutations: regrain_copy_validates_not_valid_check and regrain_drift_compares_not_valid_check each restore the acceptance failure alone. regrain_drift_excuses_validated_copy_check does not, by design: it targets the drift rule's copy side (test part C, the wedge after a drop and NOT VALID re-add), a cousin defect the PR also fixes, and the body says so. (5) The CHANGELOG and reference.md entries add no refusal of a documented workflow. The only behaviour change an operator meets is one restart of an in-flight run.
